units.source_text: “就是让人把没有的东西想成‘有’，所谓幻想教育呀……

en.t: It is what you might call education in illusion: making people imagine that something that is not there actually is...

units.source_text: 所以，你瞧，沙子既是固体，

en.t: So, you see, sand may be a solid,

units.source_text: 但多少又具备一些流体力学的性质，

en.t: but to some extent it also has certain properties of fluid dynamics,

units.source_text: 我在这一点上，感到非常有兴趣……”

en.t: and that is what I find extremely interesting..."
